_description: Training recipe for the BC-ResNet command classifier (2026-09-30), adapted from the wakeword recipe (../../model/train_config.json). Keys starting with '_' are documentation.
_epochs: 60 x 375 steps = 22,500 steps. Measured 2026-09-30 over 300 steps from scratch: training loss 3.1 -> 2.0 on clean clips, 3.2 -> 2.8 with the Pi-like augmentation, 3.2 -> 2.9 with augmentation + SpecAugment: the augmentation makes each example harder, so it needs many more steps than the clean data would.
_spec_augment: Time masks up to 150 ms: shorter than any deciding word (a number, 'Jane', 'up'/'down'), so a mask cannot turn a command into another one; it can hide a syllable.
selection: mean of owner / public / synthetic command macro accuracy and 1 - unknown false-action rate on validation (argmax)
_selection: Validation only. The owner validation clips are one session of one speaker (13:36-13:55), so the selection is not tuned to speaker2 or to the test session.
